comment: Canonical SRAM22 TOML configuration options. The config table renders from this file, and scripts/check-docs.mjs verifies the option names against the SramConfig struct in src/blocks/sram/mod.rs.

options.name: num_words
options.purpose: Number of words (depth) of the SRAM.

options.name: mux_ratio
options.purpose: Column-mux ratio M: how many columns share one sense amplifier / write driver.

options.name: write_size
options.purpose: Write-mask granularity in bits. data_width must be an integer multiple of write_size.

options.name: pex_level
options.purpose: Parasitic-extraction level. Only available on a commercial (BWRC) install; ignored otherwise.

constraints: data_width must be an integer multiple of write_size.
The number of rows, num_words / mux_ratio, must be a power of two.
pex_level, if set, must be one of "r", "c", "rc", or "rcc" (ignored without commercial plugins).
